text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

Send for yourself men, and let them survey the land of the Canaanites! which I give to the sons of Israel for a possession. [[2]man [1]One] per tribe; according to the peoples of their patrimony you shall send them, all being chiefs of them.

And these are; ; their names. Of the tribe of Reuben was Shammua son of Zaccur.
Of the tribe of Simeon was Shaphat son of Hori.
Of the tribe of Judah was Caleb son of Jephunneh.
Of the tribe of Issachar was Igal son of Joseph.
Of the tribe of Ephraim was Oshea son of Nun.
Of the tribe of Benjamin was Palti son of Raphu.
Of the tribe of Zebulun was Gaddiel son of Sodi.
Of the tribe of Joseph of the sons of Manasseh was Gaddi son of Susi.
Of the tribe of Dan was Ammiel son of Gamalli.
Of the tribe of Asher was Sethur son of Michael.
Of the tribe of Naphtali was Nahbi son of Vophsi.
Of the tribe of Gad was Geuel son of Machi.
These are the names of the men which Moses sent to survey the land. And Moses named ; Oshea son of Nun -- Joshua.
And [[2]sent [3]them [1]Moses] to survey the land of Canaan. And he said to them, Ascend in this ; wilderness! And you shall ascend into the mountain.
And you will behold the land, what it is, and the people ; lying in wait upon it, if they are strong or weak; or if; they are few, or many.
And what the land is like; in which these lie in wait upon it, if it is good, or wicked; and what the cities in which these dwell in them, if in walled or in unwalled.

And what the land is like, if plentiful or being neglected; if there is in it trees or not. And attending to constantly you shall take from the fruits of the land. And the days were days in spring, forerunners of the grape.
And ascending they surveyed the land from the wilderness of Zin until Rehob, entering Hamath.
And they ascended by the wilderness, and came unto Hebron; and there was Ahiman, and Sheshai, and Talmai, the families of Anak; and Hebron [[2]seven [3]years [1]was built] before ; Tanin of Egypt.

And they came unto the Ravine of the Cluster. And they beat from there a vine branch and [[2]cluster [3]of the grape [1]one] from it; and they lifted it upon bearing poles, and some; from the pomegranates, and ; the fig-trees.
And ; that place they named Ravine of the Cluster, on account of the cluster of grapes which [[4]beat [5]from there [1]the [2]sons [3]of Israel].

And having gone, they came to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran Kadesh. And they answered to them a word, and to all the congregation. And they showed the fruit of the land.
And they described to him, and they said, We came into the land unto which you sent us, a land flowing milk and honey. And this is; ; its fruit.

And Amalek dwells in the land, in the land; to the south; and the Hittite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the mountainous area; and the Canaanite dwell by the sea, and by the Jordan river.
And Caleb quelled the people before Moses, and said to him, Not so, but ascending we will ascend, and we shall inherit it; for by might we shall be able to prevail; against them.
And the men, the ones going up with him said, We are not ascending; for in no way should we be able to ascend to that nation, for [[2]stronger [4]than us [1]it is [3]rather].
